title: Binding of the exante-app design repo to the N0 common SaaS design-constraint policy

classification.decision: B2B SaaS: a sales-led product for company finance teams with an app sign-in/sign-up, a demo-request conversion, ERP/accounting integrations, a SOC 2 badge and a Free Plan in its terms. No pricing page exists in the clone (pricing is handled through sales), so pricing-tier templates are absent rather than out of scope.

evidence.claim: self-serve sign-up CTA in the hero
plans and pricing handled via sales
SOC 2 compliance badge in the footer
Customer Data and Fees clauses, a Free Plan in the terms

generationRules: Pages are composed only from the 9 templates and the section contracts in this repo; mode is required (clone | generation).
mode=generation pages carry none of the source's identity or content: GENERATION_MODE_BRAND/_PERSON/_CUSTOMER/_CLAIM/_COPY/_URL/_EMBED/_ASSET/_SCREENSHOT in schema/semantic_validate.py.
Real customer, partner and credential logos, real people's photos, the SOC 2 badge and live endpoints are blocked for generation (assets/asset-roles.json availability, pinned in code).
Styling only through approved tokens (tokens/llm/token-policy.json slots); no raw colours, arbitrary spacing or unsupported fonts.
No section may hold a whole page: extraction/wrapper_gate.py (HERO 1800/3000px, page share 50/60%).
contentHashCovers: policy/design-policy.json plus every enforcedBy file, in sorted path order: sha256 over '<path>\n<bytes>\n' per file (extraction/policy_hash.py)

approval.note: Category binding chosen by an agent from the evidence above (agent attestation, not a human sign-off). A human architecture owner must ratify it; no human has reviewed the pinned leakage patterns.
